messages:
alex (infra): Heads-up — eu-west1 H100 on-demand rates spiked ~28% on the latest invoice, looks like billline INV-2026-03-12. This shifts our GPU unit cost materially for Dedicated pricing. Need quick sensitivity: 0%, +15%, +28% for next 12 months. Can finance run margin impact and suggest commit sizing? :eyes:

maria (finance): Copy. Can you paste the invoice snippet and which SKU exactly? I can run a short model. Link to our modeling sheet coming once I have SKUs.

alex (infra): Here you go, pulled from billing export:
```
invoice: INV-2026-03-12
region: eu-west1
sku: GPU_H100_ONDEMAND
prev_month_rate: 16.50 USD/hr
this_month_rate: 21.12 USD/hr
delta: +28.0%
note: spot rates unchanged but capacity spot availability degraded during peak windows
```

maria (finance): Thanks. I'll run 3 scenarios against current Dedicated commit mix. Preliminary ask: add a column for per-inference cost assuming average token length 75 and avg latency profile we use. I have the sheet: https://docs.internal/redwood/cost-models/h100-eu-sensitivity (view only)

ryan (sre): Quick operational note: eu-west1 has limited additional A100/H100 spare capacity for Dedicated bursts next quarter. If we recommend pushing more committed capacity into eu-west1, need to verify provisioning windows. We may need cross-region routing fallback.

jamie (runtime): For per-inference numbers, remember we also saw a 12% increase in tail latency on H100 when load hits 80% due to kernel stalls. That increases effective vGPU-hours per request because of longer context keepalive. Add a conservative perf penalty of +10% in the model.

maria (finance): Initial numbers from the sheet (rough):
- baseline (no change): unit GPU cost per vGPU-hr = 16.50 -> margin steady at ~28% for Hosted API baseline
- scenario A (+15%): 19.00 USD/hr -> margin drops to ~21% unless we adjust price or reduce other costs
- scenario B (+28%): 21.12 USD/hr -> margin drops to ~16% before offsets
I added rows for commit buy-downs (1yr, 3yr) and show break-even for 1yr commit at ~35% utilization.

alex (infra): Thanks. Key asks: 1) For Dedicated renewals coming up in May, which clusters should we convert to 1yr reserved vs keep on-demand? 2) For Hosted API pricing, how much do we need to move per-token to preserve target gross margin of 25% assuming scenario B and current traffic mix?

maria (finance): 1) Suggest converting steady-state clusters in us-west2 and us-east1 with >60% utilization to 1yr reserved now. eu-west1 is trickier because of supply constraints; only convert critical pools. 2) To preserve 25% margin under scenario B we'd need ~8-10% list price increase for H100-backed endpoints, or 6% if we can recover 4% via improved batching/caching.

ryan (sre): Operational constraint: we can enable more aggressive prefix caching and reduce cold-starts, which could buy ~3-5% unit cost savings. But it will take 2 sprints to implement safely (tests + rollout).

jamie (runtime): I can prioritize batching improvements and a new KV-cache prewarm for priority endpoints. Estimate ~4% token-cost reduction for chat-heavy workloads after rollout.

maria (finance): Combining commits + ops recovery, the gap narrows: with 1yr commits on selected pools + ops improvements, effective unit cost under scenario B moves to ~17.8 USD/hr -> margin ~23%. That keeps us inside SLA/price change leeway.

alex (infra): Action items summarized:
- maria: finalize sensitivity sheet and produce per-product delta to present to pricing by EOD tomorrow
- ryan: validate cluster provisioning timelines for Dedicated in eu-west1 and possible cross-region fallback options, due in 48h
- jamie: scope batching/KV prewarm rollout, rough ETA 2 sprints
- billing-bot: attach invoice and billing export for INV-2026-03-12 to the thread

billing-bot: Attached billing export for INV-2026-03-12: https://billing.cloudprovider.com/invoice/INV-2026-03-12/download.csv :page_facing_up:

maria (finance): I'll prepare a short slide with recommended commit sizes and the price-sensitivity table for the pricing review on Friday. If we need a quick customer-facing note, we'll minimize calls but prepare a targeted communication plan. :chart_with_upwards_trend:

alex (infra): Thanks team. Will loop in product/pricing once maria has slides. If eu-west1 capacity worsens, we'll need an immediate fallback plan for Dedicated customers.

ryan (sre): Noted. I'll also run a short health check on H100 pools and post results here.

jamie (runtime): I'll start the batching prototype today and post perf diffs in this thread.

maria (finance): Uploading final sheet in ~6 hours.

alex (infra): Great, thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
